events.content: Chapter 1: Management Kickoff Case Challenge has started.

What is this chapter about?
Teams meet with their colleague Jamie, who is seeking advice on how to handle a dilemma she is facing with her team: her employees have different understandings of how to use after-hours communication. At the end of the conversation, teams give Jamie advice on what to do next.

What to look for:
  • Do teams explore the resources and get into the conversation quickly?
  • Do teams ask questions to better understand the situation?
  • Do any teams explore the tradeoffs between different approaches that Jamie might take?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.

Suggestion: You might consider using the Send Message feature to remind participants:

Keep exploring! The more you ask Jamie, the more she'll tell you.
Decision Time! Teams must say what they think Jamie should do next. There is not a "right" answer. Rather, each team's response will reveal something about that team's own priorities.
